description: When the caller supplies an executive's actual sourced quote, the ghostwritten piece must carry that opinion verbatim rather than paraphrasing it into something the executive never said.

input.sourced_opinion_or_quote: Boards keep asking finance for a single number and keep getting five different ones back.

rubric.condition: The output contains the exact string Boards keep asking finance for a single number and keep getting five different ones back., taken verbatim from the supplied source.

values: Boards keep asking finance for a single number and keep getting five different ones back.

rubric.condition: The last non-empty line of the post body is exactly the string: Your Data. Delivered.
The post body contains the exact string Finance-grade trust, matching the pillar supplied in the input.
The output contains zero occurrences of any of: Imperial, Rotork, Weir, ArcelorMittal, SGB Cape, Delta.

notes: Anchored to prompt.md hard rule 1 (never fabricate an opinion — a genuinely sourced one is used verbatim) and hard rule 4 (roof line). GAR-2 baseline: proves the generic not_contains check catches an accidental client-name leak even on the happy path.
